title: Avalanche devnet: L1
description: One Avalanche L1: its consensus, the resources of its nodes, its messages, and its EVM. It follows the production L1 dashboard. Every panel shows the chain of the selected L1 on the selected nodes.

panels.title: Last Accepted Height
panels.description: The current block height: how many blocks have been finalized. A flat line means that the chain has no transactions, or that it stopped.

panels.title: Accepted Blocks
panels.description: Number of new blocks accepted (finalized) in each interval.

panels.title: Rejected Blocks
panels.description: Number of blocks that were proposed but ultimately rejected by consensus.

panels.title: Processing Blocks
panels.description: Number of blocks currently in flight: received and being evaluated, but not yet accepted or rejected. A growing number means the node is not finalizing blocks.

panels.title: Average Block Accept Latency
panels.description: The average time from when a block is first seen to when it is finalized.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_snowman_blks_accepted_sum{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_snowman_blks_accepted_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e9

panels.title: Reject Rate
panels.description: The ratio of rejected blocks to all decided blocks (accepted plus rejected).

targets.expr: sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_snowman_blks_rejected_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_snowman_blks_rejected_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_snowman_blks_accepted_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Successful Polls
panels.description: The share of Snowman consensus polls that reached a successful outcome. It reads 100% while the chain is idle.

targets.expr: (sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_snowman_polls_successful{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) + 1) / (sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_snowman_polls_successful{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_snowman_polls_failed{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) + 1)

panels.title: Successful Queries
panels.description: The share of consensus queries that received a valid response (chits) instead of a failure. A drop means that peers do not answer this node. It reads 100% while the chain is idle.

targets.expr: (sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_handler_messages{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all", op="chits"}[$__rate_interval])) + 1) / (sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_handler_messages{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all", op="chits"}[$__rate_interval])) + (sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_handler_messages{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all", op="query_failed"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_handler_messages{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all", op="chits"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) + 1)

panels.title: Stake Benched
panels.description: The total weight of validators on the bench list: validators that this node excludes from consensus queries for a while, because they did not respond.

panels.title: Validators Benched
panels.description: The number of validators currently benched.

panels.title: Polls per Accepted Block
panels.description: The average number of consensus rounds (polls) that finalize one block.

targets.expr: (sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_snowman_polls_successful{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_snowman_polls_failed{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_snowman_blks_accepted_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Outstanding Polls
panels.description: The number of consensus polls in flight: started but not yet resolved.

panels.title: Outstanding Block Requests
panels.description: The number of block fetch requests that were sent but not yet answered.

panels.title: Pending Jobs
panels.description: Consensus jobs that wait to run: blocks that wait for an ancestor before they can be issued.

panels.title: Requests Failed
panels.description: Failed requests to peers, by kind. `query_failed` is a consensus query without an answer; the others fetch blocks or the frontier of the chain.

targets.expr: sum by (op) (increase(avalanche_handler_messages{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all", op=~".+_failed"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Average Verification Time
panels.description: The average time of a successful block verification.

targets.expr: (sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_meterchainvm_verify_sum{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_meterchainvm_verify_with_context_sum{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))) / (sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_meterchainvm_verify_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_meterchainvm_verify_with_context_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))) / 1e9

panels.title: Block Verifications Failed
panels.description: The number of blocks that failed verification.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_meterchainvm_verify_err_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_meterchainvm_verify_with_context_err_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Non-Verified Blocks Pinned In Memory
panels.description: The number of blocks that were received but not yet verified, held in memory.

panels.title: Blocks Built
panels.description: The number of blocks that this node proposed.

panels.title: Build Block Failures
panels.description: The number of times a node tried to build a block and failed.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU cores that each node uses, split into AvalancheGo and the Subnet-EVM plugin process, which runs the EVM.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident memory of each node, split into AvalancheGo and the Subnet-EVM plugin process. The package limits a node to 1.5 GB in total.

panels.title: CPU used by the chains
panels.description: CPU that the resource tracker of AvalancheGo attributes to message handling, in cores. AvalancheGo throttles peers by this number.

panels.title: Disk available
panels.description: Free space on the disk that holds the database of each node. All nodes of a devnet share the disk of the machine.

panels.title: Disk reads and writes
panels.description: Bytes per second that each node reads from and writes to its disk.

panels.title: Goroutines and open files
panels.description: Goroutines and open file descriptors of AvalancheGo.

panels.title: Messages Received Per Second
panels.description: Consensus and application messages that each node handles for the chain.

panels.title: Messages by Kind
panels.description: The same messages by kind, over the selected nodes. `chits` answer a consensus query; `put` and `push_query` carry a block.

panels.title: Unprocessed Messages
panels.description: Messages that wait in the queues of the chain. A queue that grows means that the node handles messages too slowly.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (avalanche_handler_sync_unprocessed_msgs_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}) + sum by (node) (avalanche_handler_async_unprocessed_msgs_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"})

panels.title: Messages Deferred for CPU
panels.description: Rate of messages whose handling was deferred because their sender used too much CPU of this node.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (rate(avalanche_handler_sync_unprocessed_msgs_excessive_cpu{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (node) (rate(avalanche_handler_async_unprocessed_msgs_excessive_cpu{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Stake Connected
panels.description: Share of the stake of the L1 that each node is connected to.

panels.title: Peers
panels.description: Number of peers of each node, on the Primary Network and the L1 together.

panels.title: Share of Block Insert Time
panels.description: Where the EVM spends the time to insert a block, over the selected nodes: validation, state initialization, execution, trie operations, and writes.

targets.expr: sum (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_chain_block_validations_content{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_chain_block_inserts{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_chain_block_inits_state{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_chain_block_inserts{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_chain_block_executions{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_chain_block_inserts{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_chain_block_trie{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_chain_block_inserts{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_chain_block_validations_state{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_chain_block_inserts{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_chain_block_writes{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_chain_block_inserts{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Gas Per Block
panels.description: Average gas that one block uses.

targets.expr: max by (node) (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_chain_block_gas_used_processed{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) / max by (node) (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_chain_block_inserts_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Gas Processed Per Second
panels.description: Gas that each node executes per second.

panels.title: Nanoseconds Per Gas
panels.description: Time to verify blocks, divided by the gas they use. It compares the cost of execution between nodes and over time.

targets.expr: (sum by (node) (rate(avalanche_meterchainvm_verify_sum{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (node) (rate(avalanche_meterchainvm_verify_with_context_sum{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by (node) (rate(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_chain_block_gas_used_processed{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Acceptor Queue Size
panels.description: Blocks that consensus accepted and that wait for the EVM to finish them: index the transactions and write the state.

panels.title: Bad Blocks
panels.description: Blocks that a node could not execute. Any bad block is serious.

panels.title: Transactions Per Second
panels.description: Transactions that each node executes per second.

panels.title: Pending Transactions
panels.description: Transactions in the pool that can go into the next block.

panels.title: Queued Transactions
panels.description: Transactions in the pool that wait for an earlier nonce of their sender.

panels.title: Tx Pool Slots
panels.description: Slots of the transaction pool in use. One slot holds 32 KB.

panels.title: Transactions Admitted and Rejected
panels.description: Transactions that the pool accepted as valid, rejected as invalid, or rejected because their fee was too low.

panels.title: RPC Requests Per Second
panels.description: Requests to the EVM RPC API of each node, and the ones that failed.

panels.title: TrieDB Dirty Size
panels.description: Size of the trie nodes that are in memory and not yet written to disk.

panels.title: TrieDB Dirty Nodes
panels.description: Number of trie nodes that are in memory and not yet written to disk.

panels.title: Memcache Flush Bytes
panels.description: Bytes of trie nodes that were flushed from memory to disk to stay under the memory limit.

panels.title: Commit Bytes
panels.description: Bytes of trie nodes that were committed to disk with a block.

panels.title: Trie Memcache Clean Hit Rate
panels.description: Share of reads of clean trie nodes that the memory cache answered.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (rate(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_hashdb_memcache_clean_hit{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (node) (rate(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_hashdb_memcache_clean_hit{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (node) (rate(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_hashdb_memcache_clean_miss{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Snapshot Account Hit Rate
panels.description: Share of account reads that the state snapshot answered from its clean cache.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (rate(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_state_snapshot_clean_account_hit{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (node) (rate(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_state_snapshot_clean_account_hit{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (node) (rate(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_eth_state_snapshot_clean_account_miss{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Decided Block Cache Hit Ratio
panels.description: Share of lookups in the cache of decided blocks that found their block.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_chain_state_decided_cache_get_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all", result="hit"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_chain_state_decided_cache_get_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Missing Block Cache Hit Ratio
panels.description: Share of lookups in the cache of missing blocks that found their block.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_chain_state_missing_cache_get_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all", result="hit"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_chain_state_missing_cache_get_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Bytes to ID Block Cache Hit Ratio
panels.description: Share of lookups in the cache of bytes to id blocks that found their block.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_chain_state_bytes_to_id_cache_get_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all", result="hit"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_chain_state_bytes_to_id_cache_get_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Unverified Block Cache Hit Ratio
panels.description: Share of lookups in the cache of unverified blocks that found their block.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_chain_state_unverified_cache_get_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all", result="hit"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_subnetevm_vm_chain_state_unverified_cache_get_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Bootstrap Finished
panels.description: 1 once a node has caught up with the chain and takes part in consensus.

panels.title: Bootstrapping Fetched Blocks
panels.description: Blocks that a node fetched from its peers while it caught up.

panels.title: Blocks per Get Ancestors
panels.description: Average number of blocks in one answer to a request for the ancestors of a block.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_snowman_get_ancestors_blks_sum{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (node) (increase(avalanche_snowman_get_ancestors_blks_count{job="avalanche", l1=~"$l1", node=~"$node", chain!~"P|X|C|all"}[$__rate_interval]))
